concepts.def: A letter representing an unknown or changing number.
Terms with exactly the same variable parts (e.g. 3x and 5x). Can be added.
The number in front of a variable (e.g. in 4x, the coefficient is 4).
Replacing a letter with a number to evaluate an expression.
Adding or subtracting like terms to simplify an expression.
a(b + c) = ab + ac — multiply everything inside the bracket.
